jobs.title: Engagement Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by the CEO and the CTO after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

 

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

 

The role

The Engagement team partners with forward-thinking customers to transform how they hire. This isn’t customer support - it’s strategic engagement. You’ll guide organizations through the adoption of AI in their hiring workflows, ensuring they unlock meaningful outcomes and long-term value.

As Engagement Manager, you’ll serve as the connective tissue across Customers, Product, and Sales - helping executives reimagine processes, operators embed AI day-to-day, and our internal teams sharpen strategy with deep customer insights.

Key ownership areas:

  • Build trusted, strategic partnerships with senior stakeholders, from recruiters to C-level, to drive business outcomes with AI.

  • Guide organizations through change management, onboarding, adoption, and expansion; helping them scale AI-driven workflows across teams.

  • Drive revenue outcomes by maximizing retention and unlocking expansion opportunities; ensuring customers realize long-term value while partnering with Sales to grow accounts.

  • Synthesize insights from the field to shape our Engagement methodology and influence product and sales strategies.

  • Serve as an AI thought partner: running workshops, sharing best practices, and elevating Metaview’s role as a category leader.

  • Proactively identify risks and opportunities in accounts, using product data and customer conversations to inform action.

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in consulting, customer-facing, or strategy roles at high-growth B2B startups or top-tier firms.

  • Proven ability to engage across levels - influencing executives while rolling up your sleeves with operators.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinker; comfortable making data-driven decisions.

  • Skilled in change management and guiding customers through transformation.

  • A natural communicator: able to distill complexity into clarity, whether 1:1 or at an exec workshop.

  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and energized by experimentation.

  • Deeply aligned with our brand: intelligent, low-BS, authentic, and customer-obsessed.

  • We operate a hybrid 3-day a week policy out of our San Fran office

 
 

What we offer

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

 

The role

Part solutions, part AI builder, commercially owned, on a book of smaller, faster-moving customers.

You'll carry GRR and NRR on your own book from early on. Retention is already strong across our customer base, so the ceiling now is expansion, and this seat is built for someone who wants that to be their number.

You own these accounts end to end. You run onboarding and shape the implementation around what the customer is actually trying to fix in how they hire, then stay with them as their teams and our agents change. Fewer stakeholders and shorter cycles than our largest customers, so decisions get made in the room and you find out quickly whether your call was right.

Much of that ownership is hands-on. Custom note templates, the reports their leadership is asking for, workflows that fit how they hire. You build it with them.

You'll also carry a few larger accounts, where the horizon is longer and you're moving a wider set of stakeholders toward the same outcome.

 

Key ownership areas

  • Own retention and growth on your book. GRR and NRR, with the renewals and expansion conversations that produce them.

  • Own your customers' outcomes end to end. Onboard them well, get them to value quickly, and stay close through the full customer lifecycle - because that's what the number rests on.

  • Be a partner, not a ticket queue. Run the sessions, make recommendations, and have a view on how they should be hiring and utilizing our agents.

  • Go deep on the product. Know what it does, where it bends, and what's coming.

  • Build with AI. Automations, agents, internal tools - we'd rather you engineered the admin away than powered through it.

  • Do your own analysis. We have no separate data team. You'll read usage data yourself, spot risk and expansion signals early, and know when to escalate.

  • Close the loop with Product. You'll see the same friction repeatedly before anyone else does. Make it impossible to ignore.

 
 

What you bring

  • Anywhere from 1-4 years post-academics, with some experience in one of the following: consulting, Customer-Success, or advisory; an ops, growth, GTM, analyst, chief-of-staff, or product-adjacent role at a software or AI company; or a junior role at a strong company with clear upward trajectory.

  • An appetite for the commercial side. You don't need to have owned a retention number yet, but you should want to, and be able to show you've been close to revenue, targets, or customers whose spend depended on your work.

  • Genuine, hands-on AI engagement. Shipped projects are the strongest signal, but hackathons, coursework, prompt-engineering work, published writing, or time at an AI-native company all count. What matters is that it's real.

  • Strong academic record or evidence of passions/extracurricular excellence.

  • Evidence of guiding customers or stakeholders (can be internal) through onboarding, rollout, or a change in how they work. Stakeholder management in consulting counts.

  • You're good in the room. You can run a session with an experienced operator, disagree with them, and have it land well.

  • Real product instinct. You have opinions about the tools you use and have got deep into at least one of them.

  • Structured execution - you use data and outcomes to show impact, not a list of responsibilities.

  • Clear, fast writing. Much of this job happens in Slack and email.

  • Curiosity about hiring as a craft, whether or not you've worked in it.

  • Our brand is intelligent, low-BS, authentic, and deeply customer-oriented. As a champion for our brand, you'll need to be these things too.

  • Ability to work in a hybrid model within New York.

 
 

What we offer

  • Base pay within our salary range is determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience.

  • An environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance with transparency at the heart of what we do and how we communicate.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • Unlimited AI

    • Unlimited access to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and any other AI tools you need to move faster.

  • Build your own toolkit

    • We'll provide the latest hardware, software, and equipment you need to do your best work.

  • Ramp card for success - a company card to invest in the things that help you succeed:

    • Lunches, dinners whenever you're in the office

    • Home office upgrades

    • Community memberships

    • Books and learning resources

    • Event attendance

    • Professional development

The role

Part solutions, part AI builder, commercially owned, on a book of smaller, faster-moving customers.

You'll carry GRR and NRR on your own book from early on. Retention is already strong across our customer base, so the ceiling now is expansion, and this seat is built for someone who wants that to be their number.

You own these accounts end to end. You run onboarding and shape the implementation around what the customer is actually trying to fix in how they hire, then stay with them as their teams and our agents change. Fewer stakeholders and shorter cycles than our largest customers, so decisions get made in the room and you find out quickly whether your call was right.

Much of that ownership is hands-on. Custom note templates, the reports their leadership is asking for, workflows that fit how they hire. You build it with them.

You'll also carry a few larger accounts, where the horizon is longer and you're moving a wider set of stakeholders toward the same outcome.

 

Key ownership areas

  • Own retention and growth on your book. GRR and NRR, with the renewals and expansion conversations that produce them.

  • Own your customers' outcomes end to end. Onboard them well, get them to value quickly, and stay close through the full customer lifecycle - because that's what the number rests on.

  • Be a partner, not a ticket queue. Run the sessions, make recommendations, and have a view on how they should be hiring and utilizing our agents.

  • Go deep on the product. Know what it does, where it bends, and what's coming.

  • Build with AI. Automations, agents, internal tools - we'd rather you engineered the admin away than powered through it.

  • Do your own analysis. We have no separate data team. You'll read usage data yourself, spot risk and expansion signals early, and know when to escalate.

  • Close the loop with Product. You'll see the same friction repeatedly before anyone else does. Make it impossible to ignore.

 
 

What you bring

  • Anywhere from 1-4 years post-academics, with some experience in one of the following: consulting, Customer-Success, or advisory; an ops, growth, GTM, analyst, chief-of-staff, or product-adjacent role at a software or AI company; or a junior role at a strong company with clear upward trajectory.

  • An appetite for the commercial side. You don't need to have owned a retention number yet, but you should want to, and be able to show you've been close to revenue, targets, or customers whose spend depended on your work.

  • Genuine, hands-on AI engagement. Shipped projects are the strongest signal, but hackathons, coursework, prompt-engineering work, published writing, or time at an AI-native company all count. What matters is that it's real.

  • Strong academic record or evidence of passions/extracurricular excellence.

  • Evidence of guiding customers or stakeholders (can be internal) through onboarding, rollout, or a change in how they work. Stakeholder management in consulting counts.

  • You're good in the room. You can run a session with an experienced operator, disagree with them, and have it land well.

  • Real product instinct. You have opinions about the tools you use and have got deep into at least one of them.

  • Structured execution - you use data and outcomes to show impact, not a list of responsibilities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Coding was first. Recruiting is next — and we're building it.

We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end recruiting agents that feel like coworkers. Metaview helps organizations hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate toil and augment humans for some of the world’s most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers.

Founded by the CEO and the CTO, who scaled Uber and Palantir, we have raised over $50M from top-tier investors. We are growing 5x year over year, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times.

Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We are looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

We have one value: velocity.
Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. We barely write code by hand anymore: every engineer orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll build
Day to day, you'll work on:

  • new product experiences across the hiring workflow

  • systems that turn conversational signal into structured actions and insights

  • AI-assisted features that need to feel useful, transparent, and well-integrated into the product

  • improvements to quality, speed, and reliability across both user-facing and agent-facing parts of the product

  • product problems that cut across engineering, design, product, and go-to-market context

What you'll own

In your first 3-6 months, you should:

  • own and ship meaningful product areas from problem definition through rollout

  • help shape how Metaview's AI products behave in real customer workflows

  • identify and drive improvements that make the product faster, clearer, and more valuable

  • contribute to the engineering bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're hiring across all levels, but we are excited by people who:

  • have shipped product in fast-moving software environments

  • are comfortable working across the stack, or moving outside their default lane when needed

  • care deeply about users and can translate messy problems into clear product decisions

  • combine technical strength with product sense and good judgment

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and close collaboration across functions

  • want to help build a category-defining product while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • shipping products, workflow software, or AI-enabled products

  • systems where frontend and backend decisions meaningfully shape each other

  • building products used in consequential or trust-sensitive moments

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the SF market — salary and meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct. It's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • We operate with a simplified leveling, early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games. We track the market closely and adjust when it tells us to. Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market two times a year and move comp up when it drifts — so "top 10%" stays true, not just true on your start date.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. It's tied to a real change in the work rather than an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's genuinely competitive. World-class equity option grants so we’re all owners. We keep the structure simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Health, fully covered (US). 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums — for you and your dependents.

  • Time off, unlimited. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

 

How we work

We operate with one core principle: velocity. In practice, this means we:

  • Optimize everything we do around accelerating rate of learning.

  • Do truly great work

  • Communicate openly and directly, and with full context.

All while maintaining a hard-earned reputation for craft and quality.

 

The role:

We’re at an exciting inflection point: strong customer love, clear product–market fit, and accelerating growth. As our GTM Recruiter, you’ll partner directly with GTM leadership to build a world-class commercial organization. You’ll own the full GTM recruiting lifecycle with an emphasis on Sales, while also build on the foundational systems, processes, and tools that will scale our hiring engine. All while working within the business operating at the bleeding edge of how hiring gets done with AI.

Key ownership areas:

  • Partner with the Co-founder/CEO and GTM leaders to define hiring needs across Sales, CS, and Marketing.

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for GTM roles: sourcing, outreach, screening, stakeholder alignment, interviews, and offer processes.

  • Refine our recruiting infrastructure and keep making it sharper.

    • The bigger opportunity: build a hiring machine that combines systematic rigour with human judgement; 100x'ing our capacity and leaving the competition at the starting line.

  • Develop genuine expertise in GTM talent markets. Where the best operators are, what they care about, what it takes to land them.

  • Keep leadership honest. Surface pipeline realities and translate them into clear, data-driven decisions, trade offs, and next steps.

 

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in full-cycle recruiting at a fast-paced, high-growth B2B startup (experience hiring for GTM roles desirable)

  • A skilled assessor with an unusually high bar for talent. You can assess the intangibles that separate exceptional candidates from competent ones, and sell the opportunity in the same breath.

  • A network, or the hunger and discipline to build one fast. You know where the best GTM operators are, what they care about, and how to get their attention.

  • AI-native. You've already figured out how to use it to move faster and hire better. You're not waiting for permission or a playbook.

  • Comfortable partnering directly with founders and GTM leaders. You can push back, hold the line on bar, and earn trust doing both.

  • A hunter mentality. The GTM talent market doesn't give up its best people easily. You'll find a way.

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

Mission

Help make Metaview one of the best-known and most respected product companies in San Francisco.

Why We're Hiring

The best engineers don't apply for jobs.

They join companies they've heard great things about from people they trust.

Today, Metaview has a strong reputation among recruiters.

Tomorrow, we want Metaview to be a company that every ambitious engineer in San Francisco has heard of, respects, and would seriously consider joining.

  • Which communities should we be involved in?

  • Which events should we sponsor?

  • Which events should we host ourselves?

  • How should Metaview show up in the startup ecosystem?

  • Help sponsor a Systems @ Berkeley event.

  • Coordinate a founder-engineer gathering at the office.

  • Reach out to student leaders.

  • Build relationships with South Park Commons members.

Another week:

  • Run a hackathon.

  • Coordinate an engineering meetup.

  • Bring top candidates into the office.

  • Launch a university ambassador program.

  • Evaluate whether a sponsorship is worth $15,000.

There is no fixed playbook.

The goal is simple: Increase the number of exceptional engineers who know and admire Metaview.

  • Students at Stanford, MIT, IVY Leagues, and similar know who we are.

  • We have strong relationships with key technical communities.

  • Top engineering candidates already know about Metaview before entering the process.

  • Recruiting pipeline quality has materially improved.

  • Run a conference.

  • Built a community.

  • Been a startup founder.

  • Worked in recruiting.

  • Worked in university recruiting.

  • Worked in partnerships.

  • Worked in operations.

What matters most is that you know how to create momentum.

Benefits

Do the best work of your career

You'll work directly with Metaview's leadership and product team on some of the company's highest-priority initiatives.

Unlimited AI

Unlimited access to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and any other AI tools you need to move faster.

Build your own toolkit

We'll provide the latest hardware, software, and equipment you need to do your best work.

Ramp card for success

A company card to invest in the things that help you succeed:

  • Lunches and coffees with interesting people

  • Community memberships

  • Event attendance

  • Professional development

  • Home office upgrades

  • Books and learning resources

Work alongside exceptional people

Join a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about craft, speed, and building great products.

Health, dental & vision

Comprehensive healthcare coverage.

Equity

Meaningful ownership in the company we're building together.

Flexible vacation

Take the time you need to recharge and do your best work.

Daily office perks

  • Team lunches

  • Fully stocked kitchen

  • Great coffee

  • Snacks and drinks

  • Modern office in San Francisco

Learn by doing

You'll be trusted with significant responsibility from day one and will have the opportunity to shape how Metaview attracts talent and builds its reputation.

Build one of the strongest networks in Silicon Valley

You'll spend your time meeting founders, engineers, operators, investors, students, and community leaders. If you're ambitious and curious, this role will give you access to an extraordinary network.

Compensation

Top 90% pay + meaningful equity

  • Manage Chargebee access and provide billing system support, reducing the need for sales reps to work directly in Chargebee and lowering the risk of errors.

  • Create scalable processes for recurring data requests, systems troubleshooting, and cross-time-zone handoffs.

  • Document and continuously improve go-to-market operations workflows.

  • High ownership and autonomy, with sound judgment about when to solve independently and when to escalate.

The role:

We're hiring our first Implementation Specialist to own how our customers first experience the product. You'll take new customers from signature to steady state: handle the configuration, run the training, and get every user live and productive across the Metaview agents that they’ve chosen to get started with.

A great implementation sets the whole relationship up for success. Done well, every end user sees value fast and the customer sees clear ROI against their own success criteria.

This is a brand new role, and there's a ton of room to define what great looks like as we build out the function. It's also one of the most hands-on seats in the company for learning how AI actually gets adopted inside a business. You'll see it happen across dozens of companies a year, up close, at a company defining the category.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Run the implementations for our most strategic customers: work through the plan for each new account, drive the setup, keep it on track, and make sure the customer always knows what happens next.

  • Build each customer’s version of Metaview: a lot of this is prompt engineering. You’ll write the instructions that tell Metaview's agents what a great candidate looks like for each role, give the agents context on the company and how it hires, build note templates around the customer's real interview process, and connect Metaview to their ATS and the rest of their stack. You’ll move customers onto the more advanced features once the basics are working.

  • Run the trainings: end user sessions, hiring manager onboarding, custom loom videos. Success is sustained and increasing usage from all users across all parts of the platform.

  • Watch adoption: spot the teams and users who haven't landed and go back in with targeted training or config changes. You're the customer's first call during the onboarding period, and you know when to pull in the rest of the team.

  • Leave things reusable: turn what you build into assets the next implementation can use, and share what you're learning about what makes onboarding land.

You might be:

  • A couple of years into implementation, onboarding or professional services at a B2B SaaS company with a complex, multi-module product.

  • Already working in the ops side of recruitment - you know the tools and the workflows as well as the hiring.

  • A Metaview power user who's already pushing the product further than most of our team.

  • None of these exactly, but you recognise yourself in the next section.

What you bring:

  • Project management. Not necessarily a previous job title, but one of your real strengths. Comfortable running several implementations simultaneously, each at a different stage with its own milestones, dependencies and stakeholders.

  • Product fluency. You like understanding how things work and you're happy in the detail. You'll learn to write a strong ideal candidate profile, work out why a sourcing search is returning the wrong candidates, and teach a hiring manager to get more from an agent. You're comfortable with configuration, integrations, data and prompts, and you use AI on your own work. Metaview experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Training and behaviour change. You can take a complex product and break it into pieces someone can actually use, you adjust when the room isn't following, and you know a session went well when people are using the thing a week later rather than when they said thanks.

  • Hospitality. You sweat the experience. Implementations are tailored to what each customer needs rather than running the same script, and you're easy to have on a call.

  • Systems thinking. You instinctively turn a one-off session into something reusable.

What we offer:

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • Your own Ramp card for lunch & dinner whenever you're in the office.

  • WFH & learning allowance to set up your own space, plus expense any books/resources/tools you'll need for your role.

jobs.title: Member of Product Staff, Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.

Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust.

We have one value: velocity.

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll design

Day to day, you'll own:

  • the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels

  • interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker

  • the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on

  • fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it

  • the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable

What you'll own

In your first 3–6 months, you should:

  • own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering

  • set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows

  • turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight

  • raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're likely to be excited by people who:

  • have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments

  • are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level

  • have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change

  • care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers

  • want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces

  • design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems

  • AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation

  • a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know — San Francisco

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by the CEO and the CTO after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

 

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

The role:

We’re hiring our first dedicated Mid-Market Sales Manager in New York City, alongside a counterpart in San Francisco. Each manager owns revenue, people, and performance for the Mid-Market segment in their market; in New York City, you’ll report to the VP Sales. The playbook is largely written and productive AE teams are already in place, but neither market has a finished system. You’ll build on that foundation with a high-agency team that moves fast and owns its pipeline. In your first three months, you’ll work with Recruiting to fill open roles, assess each rep’s development needs, and show measurable impact on the segment forecast through hands-on deal coaching and a stronger operating cadence.

Key ownership areas:

  • Own Mid-Market quota, revenue performance, and the segment forecast in New York City.

  • Recruit, onboard, lead, coach, and develop quota-carrying Mid-Market AEs, partnering with Recruiting to fill open roles and creating individual development plans from a team gap analysis.

  • Reinforce pipeline generation standards and MEDDPICC deal qualification, adapting the existing playbook to the team’s needs rather than building a new one from scratch.

  • Run pipeline-generation prep and wrap-ups, weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, and the reporting needed to see where performance needs attention.

  • Work alongside reps on live deals, offering direct coaching that improves deal conversion and consistency; partner with sales enablement and PMM to turn training and methodology into daily practice.

What you bring:

  • A record of leading quota-carrying sales teams to consistent quota performance in a high-velocity motion, with the ability to have an impact from the start.

  • The ability to identify, attract, and develop strong AE talent in a competitive hiring market, and to give direct, real-time coaching on deals.

  • Experience holding a high bar for pipeline generation and MEDDPICC qualification while giving high-agency reps room to own their work.

  • A builder’s approach to improving operating rhythms, reporting, and an existing sales playbook rather than relying on a finished system.

  • A growing operational playbook and readiness for second-line leadership or an expanded-region role within 12 months.

What we offer:

  • The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • All the benefits you’d expect and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

Founded by the CEO and the CTO after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners.

It's still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We're looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives.

How we work

Four principles guide us:

  • Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

  • Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient.

  • Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative.

  • End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through.

The role

We're building strategic finance from scratch, and you'd be our first hire in it. You'd be the finance partner to every function, Sales, Marketing, Engagement and Product, helping decide how we price, where we invest and how we scale. You'd also own the numbers the company runs on: the operating model, the plan, and board and investor reporting. This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Head of Finance, with no team between you and the work, and no part of it you won't touch. And you'll work closely on fundraising and investor relations.

We're looking for someone a few years into banking, consulting, PE or strategic finance who wants to own outcomes instead of advising on them. You'd build your own models, dashboards and workflows with AI at the core, not bolted on. And we want someone who'd rather build the process than inherit one.


Key ownership areas

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Engagement and Product on the decisions that drive growth: pricing and packaging, sales capacity and quota planning, unit economics and payback, and GTM efficiency.

  • Own the operating model, annual plan and forecasts, and track how we perform against them.

  • Own monthly board and investor reporting, from the numbers through to the narrative.

  • Build the analytics and dashboards leadership uses to run the business.

  • Support fundraising and investor relations: model, materials, data room and investor Q&A.

What you bring

  • 2–4 years in investment banking, consulting, private equity or strategic finance.

  • You can build an operating model from a blank sheet, not just update one.

  • You turn messy data into a clear point of view, and can explain it plainly to a founder or a board member.

  • You take a problem and own it. You'd rather deliver the answer than hand off the deck.

  • You find building the playbook appealing.

  • You're excited to use AI to do analysis faster and better, not just to use the tools you're handed.

  • Bonus: SQL or data tooling (e.g. Hex), or exposure to B2B SaaS metrics.



What's in it for you

  • An environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance with transparency at the heart of what we do and how we communicate.

  • Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI.

  • High compensation, through cash and equity.

  • Unlimited AI - Unlimited access to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and any other AI tools you need to move faster.

  • Build your own toolkit - We'll provide the latest hardware, software, and equipment you need to do your best work.

  • Ramp card for success - a company card to invest in the things that help you succeed:

    • Lunches and coffees with interesting people

    • Community memberships

    • Event attendance

    • Professional development

    • Home office upgrades

    • Books and learning resources
